articles.title: ‘Crazy Rich Asians’ HBO Series Sets Cast: Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh, Ronny Chieng Returning - Variety
articles.description: The "Crazy Rich Asians" TV series is moving forward at HBO, with film stars Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh, Ronny Chieng returning.
articles.content:
The “Crazy Rich Asians” TV series is moving forward at HBO, with four of the film’s stars returning.
